exec: pm.test('Response has message field', function() { const json = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(json.message).to.be.a('string'); });
pm.test('Version is 1.0.0', function() { const json = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(json.version).to.eql('1.0.0'); });
pm.test('Response has endpoints object', function() { const json = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(json.endpoints).to.be.an('object'); });
pm.test('Response has token', function() { const json = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(json.token).to.be.a('string'); pm.collectionVariables.set('authToken', json.token); });
console.warn('Admin login failed — seed the database first');
pm.test('Error message present', function() { const json = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(json.message).to.be.a('string'); });
